Professional Handyman Services

PINO HANDYMAN LLC has been serving DFW since 2019 when I, Miguel Pino decided to start this independent company after many years servicing as a lead maintenance in apartment complexes in the Metroplex, I specialize in quality workmanship at affordable prices. I am a professional handyman, fully licensed and insured. Not to mention my work is satisfaction guaranteed.




I believe in treating my customers’ homes and properties as my own. At PINO HANDYMAN LLC, I understand it’s tough finding time for those odd errands and even harder getting around to large projects that you would love, but think you can’t afford. Check out my services page to see everything I offer. Better yet, contact me for your free estimate on any kind of work you need.
